# gemini-react-java

> The lightweight, verified ReAct Agent library for Google Gemini in Java.
> Now with **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**, **Conversation Memory**, and **Real-time Thought Streaming**!

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): Main overview, features, installation, and quick start guide.
- [AI Context](wiki/LLM_CONTEXT.md): Optimized instructions for LLMs coding with this library.
- [Wiki](wiki/): Detailed documentation including RAG, Tools, and Personas.
